spec.headline: Shared Pools Spread Shocks. Isolated Credit Walls Them Off.
spec.subhead: Architectural containment versus systemic contagion in decentralized liquidity networks.

blocks.text: A single degraded collateral asset triggers cascading liquidation failures across unpartitioned reserves, spreading bad debt throughout the broader protocol and forcing mutualized losses across all depositors.
Losses remain strictly quarantined within sovereign position bulkheads, halting liquidation contagion at the perimeter and ensuring adjacent lending pools and system reserves remain fully protected.

focal.reason: Directs focus to isolated credit architecture as the structural mechanism halting systemic failure.

spec.disclaimer: Architectural risk assessment across shared-pool vs. isolated-account lending protocols under extreme liquidation scenarios.

defects.issue: Illegible footnote due to micro-scale typography and low contrast
defects.reason: The footnote 'Architectural risk assessment across shared-pool vs. isolated-account...' is rendered at approximately 12px with near-black gray value, making it illegible on mobile feeds and failing accessibility contrast minimums.
defects.fix: Increase footnote type size to 16px, raise text color to #8E92A4, and anchor it 64px above the bottom margin.

defects.issue: Excessive prose density in comparison columns hurts scannability
defects.reason: Both columns contain dense blocks of 8-9 lines of unbroken, narrow-column body text. This creates a wall-of-text appearance that weakens the intended focal emphasis on the right-hand column.
defects.fix: Condense each column's descriptive copy to 3-4 lines maximum or format as 2 distinct comparative bullet points with increased line-height (1.4x).

defects.issue: Top-heavy vertical distribution leaving unbalanced negative space at base
defects.reason: The card elements are clustered in the upper 80% of the artboard, leaving an awkward dead zone below the footnote rather than an intentional, balanced distribution of negative space.
defects.fix: Increase vertical spacing below the subhead by 48px and push the comparison block downward to balance the canvas vertically.
